name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A tooltip that springs from its trigger and glides between neighboring triggers, morphing its size and text.

useCases: Icon-button toolbars, editor controls, and dense action bars where hints should follow the pointer from button to button.
limitations: Tooltips inside one gliding TooltipProvider share a single popup, so only one shows at a time. Tooltip text is a hint for pointer and keyboard users; it is not announced on touch devices, so icon buttons still need an aria-label.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Wrap triggers in TooltipProvider to share delays and glide between them. Reduced motion shows and moves the tooltip instantly.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/tooltip.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
